in_marathi.name: Sanmitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanmitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sanmitha is a combination of two words: 'San' means 'Goddess' and 'Mitha' means 'Wealth'. This name is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and good fortune to the bearer.
